observations.description: Moving alongside Mara does not select her
Walking interaction key cannot accidentally talk to the follower
Walking beside Mara leaves no follower reticle
Unreticled NPC name badges are hidden
Walking beside Mara leaves no talk prompt
Stopping and looking toward Mara permits conversation
Deliberate companion focus shows both bracket and prompt
Only the reticled NPC displays a name badge
Looking away dismisses the companion target
Looking away also removes the name badge
Ordinary stationary NPCs retain their approach interaction
Mara travelling to the gate is not selected by proximity

scope: Actual exploration target, prompt and bracket with moving, stopped, looking-away and stationary-NPC fixtures.
